name: design-loop
description: Visual intelligence pyramid for frontend UI/UX. 4 tiers: /design-lint (instant CSS analysis, no browser), /design-score (5s visual score card), /design-fix (30s quick fix), /design-loop (full iteration loop). AI can code your UI, but it can't see it — design-loop gives Claude eyes. Scores against 5 anti-slop criteria. 2 loop modes: Polish (refine within tokens) and Redesign (bold transformation). Auto-discovers companion design skills. Platform-agnostic.
